WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE
       WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN date_diff('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), current_date())
       ELSE date_diff('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), CAST(p.death_date AS DATE))
     END AS player_age

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE) AS birth_date,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN current_date() ELSE CAST(p.death_date AS DATE) END AS end_date
WITH nationality,
     date_part('year', end_date) - date_part('year', birth_date) -
     CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', end_date) < date_part('month', birth_date)
         OR (date_part('month', end_date) = date_part('month', birth_date)
             AND date_part('day', end_date) < date_part('day', birth_date))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS player_age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(player_age) AS col2
